# Vitaleco

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Montevideo specialist in high-end kitchen appliances: espresso and coffee machines, cold-press juicers, blenders, dehydrators, stand mixers and water purifiers from brands such as Philips, De'Longhi, KitchenAid, Bosch, Krups and Cuisinart. Ships only within Uruguay.

*ES:* Especialista de Montevideo en electrodomésticos de cocina de alta gama: cafeteras espresso, jugueras cold press, licuadoras, deshidratadores, batidoras planetarias y purificadores de agua de marcas como Philips, De'Longhi, KitchenAid, Bosch, Krups y Cuisinart. Envía solo dentro de Uruguay.
